categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Extra-tough ghost characters that are fought on every floor of The Last Resort. Will usually drop an Elevator Button to explore more of the hotel.

categories.title: Elevator Button
categories.info: Buttons dropped by bosses that allow Luigi to explore a new floor of The Last Resort.

categories.title: Gooigi Grate
categories.info: Gooigi Grates are green pipes that can be used by Gooigi to take him to a different part of the current room. Most are double-ended, but some are one-way affairs.

categories.title: Locked Door
categories.info: A door that typically requires a Key in order to unlock.

categories.title: Boo
categories.info: Boos appear on floors where you've found the Elevator Button, and only in specific rooms. Your controller will pulse when close to the door to where a Boo is hiding, and vibrate when close to the object. If you check the wrong object, the Boo will move to a different room.

locations.title: Polterkitty #A-1
locations.description:
The first location for the Polterkitty. Enter the middle or left-hand buildings to get her under the park bench, then flash her with the Strobulb. Once exposed, face away from Polterkitty and wait for her to cover her eyes. When she uncovers them, spin around and flash her!

Unlocks [Polterkitty #A-2](#loc=386863).

locations.title: Polterkitty #A-3
locations.description:

Unlocks [Polterkitty #A-4](#loc=386865).

locations.description: Here, use both Luigi and Gooigi to Suction Shot Slam the biggest watermelon into the bathtub. Then, blow on the bath's tap to fill it with water so you can flash Polterkitty, causing her to attack. Defeat her one last time to recover the 9F Elevator Button!

Spawn area for Boodybuilder. Can be found inside:

- Laundry baskets
- Trash Bin

If not in this room, check the [Locker Room](#loc=389695), [Yoga Room](#loc=389696) and [Pool](#loc=389697).

locations.title: Boodybuilder
locations.description:
Spawn area for Boodybuilder. Can be found inside:

- Laundry baskets

If not in this room, check the [Gym Lobby](#loc=389694), [Yoga Room](#loc=389696) and [Pool](#loc=389697).

locations.title: Boodybuilder
locations.description:
Spawn area for Boodybuilder. Can be found inside:

- Laundry Baskets

If not in this room, check the [Pool](#loc=389697), [Locker Room](#loc=389695) and [Gym Lobby](#loc=389694).

locations.title: Boodybuilder
locations.description:
Spawn area for Boodybuilder. Can be found inside:

- Laundry Baskets

If not in this room, check the [Yoga Room](#loc=389696), [Locker Room](#loc=389695) and [Gym Lobby](#loc=389694).

locations.title: Boosician
locations.description:
Spawn area for Boosician. Can be found inside:

- Trash Bins

If not in this area, check the [Elevator Hall Shops](#loc=390189) and [Dance Floor](#loc=390188).

locations.title: Boosician
locations.description:
Spawn area for Boosician. Can be found inside:

- Trash Bins, including in the side areas. Use the [Strobulb Light](#loc=390184) to get to these areas.

If not in this room, check the [Elevator Hall](#loc=390187) and [Elevator Hall Shops](#loc=390189).

locations.title: Boosician
locations.description:
Spawn area for Boosician. If located here, he can only be found in the Trash Bin in this corner, making him impossible to miss in this instance.

If not in this room, check the [Elevator Hall](#loc=390187) and [Dance Floor](#loc=390188).

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Poltergust G-00](#loc=385345)

After getting the Poltergust, vacuum the sheet off the blue car parked near the red car the Pultergust was in. Flash the green light with the Strobulb to open the boot and get the Gem.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Get behind the counter with ZL + ZR, then flash the Strobulb on the green Strobe Switch light to reveal this Gem.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Vacuum the chandelier in the main hall to spin it, revealing this side area with the Red Gem on top of the table.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Vacuum the purple coat, then flash the safe with the Strobulb.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire the [Dark-Light](#loc=385490)

Once you get the [Dark-Light](#loc=385490), shine it on this gem painting to get the real one.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Unlock the Lab

After unlocking the Lab, head to this spot and fire a Suction Shot onto the potted plant. Vacuum and slam the plant to release the Gem.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Return E. Gadd to the Lab

After returning E. Gadd to the Lab, return to this spot and use your new Suction Shot on the drier. Tug on the shot's rope to free the Gem from the intense tumble-dry cycle.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: From the Laundry Room, use the Suction Shot to pull down a vent panel in the back-right corner of the room to access this Gem.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: In the mouth of the right-hand statue. To free it, vacuum the orb off the left-hand statue, then fire it at the right-hand statue.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Use the telescope until a Gem Goob ghost shows up, then defeat it to get the Gem.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

After you unlock Gooigi, return to this spot and use Gooigi to slip through the door. Use a Suction Shot to open the power box on the left-hand wall, then flash it with the Strobulb to release the Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

After unlocking Gooigi, enter back here using the [Vent Door](#loc=385757), then climb up the ladder on the right-hand side. Switch to Gooigi and drop him down the grate in the back-left, letting you grab this Gem from behind the ladder.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

After unlocking Gooigi, get to the top of these stairs, then switch to Gooigi and have him drop through the grate in the back-left of the floor. You'll drop down to the ledge where this Gem is.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

On either side of the main hall are two buttons (the right-hand one is covered by boxes you can blow away). Have Luigi and Gooigi stand on each one and then vacuum the chandelier, dropping this Gem onto the floor.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire the [Dark-Light](#loc=385490)

Once you have the Poltergust, use the Dark-Light feature to reveal the Sofa in this spot. Defeat the Gem Goob that appears, and it'll drop the White Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

Head up the left-hand stairs to the Mezzanine, then make a U-turn to the left. Blow the end of the carpet here to reveal a [Gooigi Grate](#loc=385808). Drop down as Gooigi and walk towards the Gem: use ZL + ZR to use the Burst move and dislodge it, then go grab it!

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

To get to this Gem, first clear the [Sofa barricade](#loc=385811), reveal [Princess Peach's Room 501 Door](#loc=385812) with the Dark-Light, then reveal the [Hidden Balcony Door](#loc=385813) with the Dark-Light. Once outside, head right onto the ledge and around the corner to a grotesque statue: interact with it to get the Gem!

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

For this Gem, first clear the [Sofa barricade](#loc=385811), reveal [Mario's Room 502 Hidden Door](#loc=385820), then clear the [502 Bathroom Blocked Door](#loc=385821). Here, drop down the drain as Gooigi and Suction Shot the wooden boards so you can turn the valve and redirect the water.

Back up top, use Luigi to vacuum the shower curtain and then blow on the bath taps to turn the shower on. This will reveal a yellow box: Suction Shot and Slam it to get the Yellow Gem.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

In the 507 Bathroom, reveal the [Hidden Door](#loc=385833), then enter the secret room and clear the green suitcase with a Suction Shot. Switch to Gooigi and walk through the wooden wall to get to the Gem!

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Return E. Gadd to the Lab

Use the Suction Shot on the desk below the picture of the hotel and tug on it to reveal this Gem.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: To access, reveal the [Hidden Gooigi Grate](#loc=385961) with the Dark-Light, then drop down it as Gooigi and turn the [Water Valve](#loc=385963), clearing the western Restroom. Next use a Suction Shot to reveal the [Gooigi Grate](#loc=385962) on the wall, letting you get to the western Restroom and collect this Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Flash this vending machine six times for the Gem to pop out.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Blast through [the upper Mall Lobby Gate](#loc=385988), then follow the path all the way to this Chest. The White Gem will be inside.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Inside a Chest at the end of this upper balcony. Get up here using the [Hidden Ladder](#loc=385992).

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Behind the glass of this display. If you didn't smash it in your fight for the [Heart Key](#loc=385994), you can break this by Slamming a suitcase into the glass with the Suction Shot.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Get this by using the Suction Shot on the [Mannequin Switch](#loc=385997) in the Boutique to open a [Hidden Door](#loc=385996). Enter the room and vacuum this out of the cobwebs.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Clear 5F - RIP Suites and unlock Gooigi

Use the Poltergust with both Luigi and Gooigi to turn the fan-shaped cutlery signs flanking the door at the same time. This will drop the Yellow Gem from the ceiling.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Inside a block of ice on the left-hand shelf. Vacuum it, then use the [Stoves](#loc=386219) in the Kitchen to defrost it.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Behind the dartboard. Shoot at the dartboard with a [Wall-Mounted Sword](#loc=386225) to access it.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Inside the right-hand cubicle. Access with a Suction Shot, then vacuum the floating newspaper to expose the Gem Goob.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Blow into the mouthpiece of the tuba and get the Purple Gem to reveal itself, then use Gooigi to suck the Gem off so you can collect it.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Flash the popcorn machine with the Strobulb three times to make it overflow, releasing the Yellow Gem.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Use the Dark-Light to reveal the right-hand faucet (which is reflected in the mirror), then use the faucet to reveal a Gem Goob with the White Gem on them.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: After passing through the [Boo Door](#loc=386398), use the vacuum on the bottles to the right of this safe to play the Luigi's Mansion theme, unlocking the safe and revealing the Blue Gem.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Use the Dark-Light on the piano to reveal the missing keys, then interact with the piano.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Reveal the suit of armor with the Dark-Light, then use a Suction Shot Slam on it.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Use the Suction Shot on the blank section of wall to reveal a secret area with a Chest, with the Purple Gem inside.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Suction Shot the right-hand keg, then head inside. Go left and climb up the ladder to get to this Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Use the Suction Shot to open up the right-hand barrel. Enter it, then move right to enter the upright barrel and climb up the ladder to get to the Gem.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Blow on the fan up the left-hand wall to lower the cage with the Yellow Gem in it. Enter the cage with Gooigi.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Access this by going through the [Royal Coffers Hidden Door](#loc=386447).

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: In the popcorn bucket of a suit of armor. Vacuum it outta there.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light under the golden forest painting to reveal this Gem on the flowers. Vacuum it to collect it!

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Use the [Hidden Gooigi Grate](#loc=386541) in the bedside cabinet to get on top of the bed. Flash the flower bulb there to release this Gem.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description:
To get this Gem, first vacuum the three petal piles in the bathtub, revealing the Gem. Next, vacuum the petal pile in the southwest corner of the room to reveal a [Gooigi Grate](#loc=386547).

Drop down as Gooigi, then vacuum the leafy vines in the northeastern corner. This reveals a hidden [Gooigi Grate](#loc=386550) you can use to get up to the Gem!

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description:
This Gem requires a bit of setup. First, use the Dark-Light to reveal the [Hidden Gooigi Grate](#loc=386557) in front of the toilet. Drop down as Gooigi, then shine the Dark-Light on the eastern wall to reveal a hidden section of the drainpipe.

Back as Luigi, blow on the faucet of the bathtub to fill it with water. Switch back to Gooigi, and a leak in the drainpipe will water a flower. Flash it with the Strobulb to get the Gem.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: In the Mushroom Suite, head through the bed curtains to go down [a ramp to the basement](#loc=386565). Here, look for a [Gooigi Grate](#loc=386564) in the back wall, which will take you to a Flower Bulb with the Green Gem in it.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: When you get to the top of the blue plant in the stairwell, cross to the left side and suck on the curled-up fern to unfurl it. Cross it, then vacuum the vines on the back wall to get between the bars and the glass. Head right over the ledge with coins, and you'll come at a crow's next with the Blue Gem in i.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Vacuum the blades of the helicopter to lower it, allowing the Gem to pop out of the passenger seat.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: To get this, use Luigi to pull on the brass orb on the front desk facade, popping this Gem out on the back wall. Use Gooigi to go through the barricade on the left side of the desk to get to the Gem.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Use a Suction Shot Slam to destroy the potted plant, then vacuum the carpet corner it was on to reveal this Gem from the floor.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Vacuum the ET-like blanket wrap in the basket of the purple bicycle to reveal a Gem Goober, who'll drop the White Gem.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Use Gooigi to squeeze inside the giant bottle to collect this Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description:
On the lighting rig above the director. Before starting, make sure you have the Torch from the Castle Set and set it on fire in the Fire Set.

Head to the northwest corner and have Luigi stand on the cherrypicker, then have Gooigi use the vacuum on it to raise it up. As Luigi, get the ice block down to the ground, then melt it with the Torch!

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Use the vacuum to spin the chair behind the desk: this will flip the desk around, revealing a chest with this Gem in it.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Vacuum the flowers in front of the column on the right-hand side of the corridor to reveal a Strobulb Light. Flash it to raise the fossil at the end of the corridor and reveal a safe. Flash the save to get a bunch of treasure and the Blue Gem!

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Fire Toad at this display case to release a Gem Goob. If Toad is unavailable, a bone from the main skeleton hall where you fought [Ug](#loc=387314) will do just as well.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Fire Toad at this display case to smash it. If Toad is unavailable, a bone from the main skeleton hall where you fought [Ug](#loc=387314) will do just as well.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Fire Toad at the Pterodactyl hanging above the elevator to release the Green Gem. If Toad is unavailable, a bone from the main skeleton hall where you fought [Ug](#loc=387314) will do just as well.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: From the [Waterworks Key](#loc=387799), head left to go up a hidden ramp behind the wall that takes you to the Yellow Gem.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description:
To get here, first use the [Gooigi Grate](#loc=387812) behind the yellow janitor's trundler to get to the main part of the Storage Room. Have Luigi turn the [Water Valve](#loc=387813) so that Gooigi can get to the next [Gooigi Grate](#loc=387819) behind the cardboard box, taking him to this room's basement.

Luigi should then turn the [Water Valve](#loc=387813) back the other way, allowing Gooigi to get the Red Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light in the southwest corner of the room to reveal a part of the water system, then flash the Strobulb on the light in the northeast corner of the room. This will reveal the Blue Gem!

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Lower the water

After lowering the water, look for the ball and chain in this spot. Have Gooigi stand on the nearby platform, then have Luigi vacuum the ball to raise him up. This will allow Gooigi to reach the Green Gem on the ceiling with his vacuum.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: After lowering the water, enter the submarine using the [Gooigi Grate](#loc=387882) breaking through the floor. Here, take the flaming log on the left and use it to light the stovebox on the right.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Use Luigi to pull on a brass ball and chain (obscured by a pot between it and the camera) to open the mouth of the snake statue. The Red Gem is in its mouth, but you will have to defend yourself against three bats first.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Use the vacuum to excavate this buried stone snake, then use the Dark-Light to fill in the missing mid- and tail-sections so the snake will release the Gem from its mouth.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Inside the cone-shaped sand dune. Get it by vacuuming up the sand.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Suction shot these nesting doll-style sarcophagi until a Gem Goob bursts out.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Defeat the Hammers in this room

Head down this room's [Gooigi Grate](#loc=388323) to enter its basement, then head right and open the chest.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Access by firing the [Cross Jewel](#loc=388326) into the slot on this wall.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Walk in front of the wheel to cause some ghostly swords to stab into it. Then, spin the wheel with the vacuum to get some more swords in the wheel. These will form a square shape, revealing the Gem!

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description:
Vacuum all six playing cards in this room. They can be found in the following spots:

- On the blue cabinet on the back wall
- On the floor between the two doors
- On the rug next to the bath
- Between the bath and the camera
- On the window sill above the bath
- Also on the sill above the bath
- Pinned above the toilet by a sword

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Up inside this glass cabinet. Use Gooigi to flash the [Strobulb Light](#loc=389033) to briefly open it, then vacuum the Gem out.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Inside one of the three Piggy Banks in the corners of the room. The Gem will always be in the last Piggy Bank you break open.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light at this spot on the wall to get the Gem (you can see the painting reflected in the northeast mirror).

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Wear the giant top-hat in this room and use a Burst (ZL + ZR) to launch it onto the statue ghost with no top hat on. This will reveal some spectral spiral stairs leading up to a chest with this Gem in it.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visiting E. Gadd after visiting 12F: The Spectral Catch

After meeting the above requirement, the story will take you to this room. In this spot, fire any paint can at the brick wall to reveal a Gem Goob!

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Super Suction

This Gem can only be acquired once the story has you revisit B2: Boilerworks to unlock the Super Suction ability. Once you've done so, return to this floor and use the nearby Super Suction Socket in the southwest corner to tear open the carpet rug at this spot.

Use a Burst (ZL + ZR) to break open the floorboards where the red X is to uncover the Gem.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Super Suction

To get this Gem, use Super Suction to reveal the [Gooigi Grate](#loc=389560) on the northwest corner of the room. Take it to get behind the front desk: vacuum the globe off the wall shelf and fire it over the counter so Luigi can use it.

Take the globe and fire it at the hanging glass ball in this corner to get the Gem!

media.title: The Spectral Catch - Yellow Gem A
The Spectral Catch - Yellow Gem B

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Shine the Dark Light on this box to reveal a ball and rope. Yank it to raise a jolly roger that knocks this Gem out of a skull's mouth, letting you retrieve it.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Buried under the pile of sand on this small island. Reach this island by revealing the [first](#loc=389570) and [second](#loc=389571) Hidden Bridges on the right-hand side of the beach.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Vacuum the sand on the island after the first [Hidden Bridge](#loc=389570).

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: At this spot is a little mermaid ghost statue. Destroy it with three coconuts to reveal a Gem Goob!

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Super Suction

After the story takes you through B2: Boilerworks a second time and getting the Super Suction upgrade, use the [Super Suction Socket](#loc=389588) to rip down the back wall of the stage, revealing a Ghost Orchestra.

Vacuum them and their platforms to reveal a TV. Activate it with the Strobulb, then step through it to be taken to a balcony. Vacuum the box of popcorn here to get the Gem!

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: To get this Gem, have both Luigi and Gooigi stand on the round fresco in the Elevator Hall. This opens the trophy cabinet: vacuum the Yellow Gem from the top shelf!

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Use the Dark-Light to reveal a bell on the table. Walk away from the table to the other side of the room, and it'll ring three times. Return to the bell and ring it three times again to reveal a Gem Goob.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: Fire the soccer ball at the swimming sign to reveal the Blue Gem for this floor.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: To get this, have Gooigi stand on the [Scales](#loc=389626), opening a secret compartment on this column (visible in the mirror on the back wall). Use Luigi to go grab it.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Use the [Radio](#loc=389628) three times to reveal this Gem Goob on the treadmill.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Use the [Gooigi Grate](#loc=389644) to drop into this room's basement, then blow on the red valve to lower the water. This will let Gooigi pass through the grate to the Gem!

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Use Luigi to vacuum on the turntable on the left wall, causing a block of bricks to extend from this wall. As Gooigi, stand under the Brick Block and use the Burst move (ZL + ZR) to headbutt it. On the fifth, this Gem will appear!

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: Inside the Hidden Vault. Access this by solving the [Dance Floor](#loc=390169) puzzle, then walking through the jailbars as Gooigi.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Vacuum all six coats on the left-hand side of this room to reveal the Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Use the [Super Suction Socket](#loc=390182)

In the back room, shine the Dark-Light on the mannequin head that's missing a red afro. After it's revealed, vacuum the afro off to reveal the Gem.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Use the [Strobulb Light](#loc=390184)

On this side of the Dance Hall, shine the Dark-Light at the spot closest to the camera where a floating lamp is. This will reveal a Gem Goob with the White Gem on them.

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Use the [Strobulb Light](#loc=390184)

Use Mario and Gooigi to vacuum the turntables in the elevated sections flanking the dance floor. This will drop the disco ball and release the Gem.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description: Use the [Gooigi Grate](#loc=390193) in the back-left corner of the main lounge area to get on top of the elevator shaft. Here, check the northern wall to find an alcove that drops you down to where the Purple Gem is. You may have to wiggle Gooigi around in front of the Purple Gem before you're able to pick it up.

locations.title: Green Gem
locations.description: Have Luigi and Gooigi stand on the small tables between the couches on the east and west sides of the seating area.

locations.title: White Gem
locations.description: Vacuum the object to the south of this painting to case a shadow of King Boo, and then Luigi. This will reveal the Gem, and a bunch of treasure to boot!

locations.title: Red Gem
locations.description: Take the [Book](#loc=390216) from downstairs and slot it into the empty spot here to get this Gem.

locations.title: Blue Gem
locations.description: To get this, enter the basement of this room using [Gooigi Grate 5](#loc=390299), then use [Gooigi Grate 6A](#loc=390303) to get up to the Gem.

locations.title: Yellow Gem
locations.description: To get this, yank the mannequin switch with the Suction Shot to flip the floor into a see-saw. Walk left and right to raise it upwards: the Yellow Gem will be at the very top, behind some bars that only Gooigi can pass through.

locations.title: Purple Gem
locations.description:
Fire Toad at this display case to smash it. If Toad is unavailable, a bone from the main skeleton hall where you fought [Ug](#loc=387314) will do just as well.

Once it's open, use the Dark-Light to reveal the Purple Gem on one of the stands.

locations.title: Grand Lobby Key
locations.description: Behind the front counter. Use a Blast with ZL + ZR to open the way back there.

locations.title: Restrooms Key
locations.description: Inside the toilet in this cubicle. Get it by pulling down the door with a Suction Shot.

locations.title: Heart Key
locations.description: Use the [Diamond Key](#loc=385986) on the cash register, then defeat the Goobs.

locations.title: Spade Key
locations.description: Use the [Heart Key](#loc=385994) on the cash register, flash the Strobulb behind it, then defeat the swarm of mini Goobs.

locations.title: Club Key
locations.description: Use the [Spade Key](#loc=386001) on the [Hidden Cash Register](#loc=386009).

locations.title: Star Key
locations.description: Reveal by using the [Club Key](#loc=386008) on the [Hidden Cash Register](#loc=386011).

locations.title: Antechamber Key
locations.description: Access by using the Suction Shot on the middle barrel.

locations.title: Dungeon Key
locations.description: Inside the Chest.

locations.title: Bridge Room Key
locations.description: Surrounded by water. To collect this, use Gooigi to pull the ball and chain next to [the Bridge Room Locked Door](#loc=386445), then collect the Key with the normal Luigi.

locations.title: Illusion Bathroom Key
locations.description: Inside the Possessed Chest. To defeat it, have it eat Gooigi, then shine the Dark-Light on it to un-possess it.

locations.title: Gym Lobby Key
locations.description: As you explore this room, a water polo ball will be thrown at the window, unfogging a spot on it. Peer through this and watch the boss ghost to spawn several ghosts into the room. The last one will have the Key on them.

locations.title: Training Room Key
locations.description: Use any three pieces of gym equipment in this room (the treadmills or bikes) to reveal this Key.

locations.title: Exterior Key
locations.description: Inside the chest at the far end of the leddge.

locations.title: Library Key
locations.description: To get this, Suction Shot the [Power Box](#loc=390214) on the lower floor.

locations.title: Drawing Room Key
locations.description: Get this by using the [Painting Fan](#loc=390285) to access and turn off the [Power Switch](#loc=390283), disabling the lasers, then using the Painting Fan again to turn the middle of the room to this Key.

locations.title: Master Bathroom Key
locations.description: Access this by turning off the Power Switch, then blowing on the bath taps with the vacuum.

locations.title: Master Bedroom Key
locations.description: Get to this by yanking the right-hand mannequin with a Suction Shot, then tilt the platform left and right to get to the Power Switch that disables the lasers.

locations.title: Vending Machine
locations.description: Pull down the vending machine with a Suction Shot to access a back room.

locations.title: Shelves
locations.description: **Prerequisite:** [Poltergust G-00](#loc=385345)

locations.title: Sinks
locations.description: **Prerequisite:** [Poltergust G-00](#loc=385345)

locations.title: Valve
locations.description: **Prerequisite:** [Poltergust G-00](#loc=385345)

locations.title: Shelf
locations.description: **Prerequisite:** [Poltergust G-00](#loc=385345)

locations.title: Shelf
locations.description: **Prerequisite:** [Poltergust G-00](#loc=385345)

locations.title: Chest
locations.description: Inside a chest under the stairs.

locations.title: Front Desk
locations.description: Flash the [Strobe Switch](#loc=385469) in the back-right corner of the front desk to raise the back wall.

locations.title: Peach Sign
locations.description: Break by firing a pumpkin at it.

locations.title: Luigi Sign

**Prerequisite:** Super Suction

After the story takes you through B2: Boilerworks a second time and getting the Super Suction upgrade, return to this spot. Defeat the Ghost Ballerinas, then use a Burst (ZL + ZR) on the dark tile of the floor to reveal a Super Suction outlet.
